text:
[Council File 26-1477]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CHAIR, ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE relative to establishing alternative project delivery criteria for the Grant Lake Program at Grant Lake Reservoir.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
CONCUR with action of the Board of Water and Power Commissioners of October 14, 2026, Resolution No. 027 057, which approves Grant Lake Program at Grant Lake Reservoir Resolution for an Ordinance requesting the Council to establish Alternative Project Delivery Criteria Pursuant to §371(b) of the City Charter.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Board of Water and Power Commissioners. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Asks the council to set alternative project delivery criteria for the Grant Lake Program at Grant Lake Reservoir, a Water and Power project.
